notes:
New
- Sweet Calendar. Plan in day, week or month views, with repeating events and time zones. Connect
  iCloud, Fastmail or another CalDAV calendar with an app password, or subscribe to a calendar's
  .ics link, and edit those events in AppSweet. When an event changed in two places, you choose
  which version to keep.
- Send later in Sweet Email. Pick a time and the message waits in the Outbox, where you can send
  it now, edit it or cancel it. You can also turn off sending for an account.
- Broadcast drafts. Every post starts as a draft that saves as you type, on all your devices.
  Write in a full-page editor, or use Quick post for something short. Plan posts on a posting
  schedule with time slots, and keep a post's images and videos in its media folder in Files,
  where you can drag them in.
- Broadcast's Planning calendar has Week and Month views.
- Broadcast checks a video before upload and tells you when a destination won't accept it.
- AppSweet opens from this Mac's copy when the server can't be reached at launch, so you can
  keep reading and working offline.
- Settings › About and updates shows the update status. When the server blocks an update, the
  app explains why and lets you ask your admin to update the server.

Improved
- Sweetheart on hosted models corrects a tool call that went wrong instead of ending the run.
- Search finds Docs and files by the name of the folder they are in, and the whole search bar
  on Today is highlighted when you use it.
- Writing email: a mistyped address stops Send, the message can't be edited while it is still
  loading, and a removed attachment stays removed.

Fixed
- After resetting your password, AppSweet leads you back to sign-in.
- A Gmail draft you continued in AppSweet no longer stays behind in Gmail after you send it.
- Files that belong to an app, such as a document's images, can be shared from Files, and the
  password and end date rows in the share dialog work again.
- Sweetheart applies a review you approved before it asked.
